translations.web: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
translations.bsb: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”
translations.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
translations.asv: for she said within herself, If I do but touch his garment, I shall be made whole.
